Network Monitoring for Enterprise IT

Gain Visibility Across Corporate Networks, Campuses, Branches, and Remote Offices

Enterprise networks span headquarters, branch offices, remote workers, and cloud applications, often managed by lean IT teams without dedicated network engineers at every site. ntopng gives enterprise IT teams centralized, application-aware visibility across every location, without requiring hardware at every branch.

Download free
Get a license
Talk to us

Why it matters

Why Enterprise IT Needs Centralized Visibility

Distributed enterprise environments create common blind spots:

  • Branch offices and remote sites with no dedicated IT staff to monitor local network health.
  • Shadow IT and unsanctioned SaaS applications consuming bandwidth without IT's knowledge.
  • Help desk tickets for "slow network" with no data to quickly identify root cause.
  • Security and compliance requirements spanning every site, not just headquarters.

The Solution

One Console for Every Site

  • Centralized dashboards (ntopng): monitor headquarters, campuses, branches, and remote offices from a single console, without needing local IT expertise at each site.
  • Application visibility (nDPI): identify exactly which applications, approved or shadow IT, are running on the corporate network, including inside encrypted traffic.
  • Lightweight branch monitoring (nProbe): deploy flow export at branch routers and firewalls to feed data back centrally, without needing full packet capture at every site.
  • Alerts and thresholds: get notified of unusual behavior, bandwidth spikes, or new devices appearing on any site's network.
  • Historical reporting: support compliance audits and internal reporting with historical, per-user and per-application activity logs.

Use Cases

Troubleshooting a branch office complaint

A remote office reports a slow application. IT reviews ntopng’s centralized dashboard and immediately sees the site’s bandwidth is saturated by a single non-business application, resolving the issue without an on-site visit.

Discovering shadow IT

nDPI-based classification reveals employees are widely using an unsanctioned file-sharing service. IT can now assess the risk and either sanction, replace, or block it based on real usage data.

Auditing remote worker and VPN activity

Compliance requires proof of network access controls across a hybrid workforce. ntopng’s historical logs provide the audit trail needed without deploying separate endpoint monitoring.

Monitoring multiple campuses from one team

A company with offices across several cities monitors all locations from a single IT team using centralized dashboards, instead of requiring dedicated staff at each site.

Detecting a rogue or unmanaged device

A new, unrecognized device appears on the corporate network. ntopng’s anomaly alerts flag it immediately, letting IT investigate before it becomes a security risk.

Why it matters

Why Enterprise IT Teams Choose ntopng

  • Centralized, multi-site visibility: one console for headquarters, branches, and remote offices.
  • No local expertise required: lightweight flow export means branch sites don't need dedicated IT staff.
  • Application-level clarity: see exactly what's running on the network, sanctioned or not.
  • Audit-ready reporting: historical data supports compliance without extra tooling.
